value.answer: Tomorrow (Tue) in Vancouver, BC: cloudy, high around 14°C, with a few showers from late evening. Some sources have a shower or two in the morning too, so that part isn't settled. In Vancouver, WA it's dry: high around 62–67°F (about 17–19°C), some cloud and sun early, then cloudy, with about a 1% chance of rain.
